name: Progress ring
description: A ring that fills up, with the percentage in the middle.
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<style>
.bg{fill:none;stroke:rgba(127,127,160,.25);stroke-width:10}
.val{fill:none;stroke:#7c8cff;stroke-width:10;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-dasharray:100;stroke-dashoffset:calc((1 - var(--v)) * 100);transform:rotate(-90deg);transform-origin:50px 50px}
[data-level="10"] .val{stroke:#34c759}
.n{font:700 22px system-ui,sans-serif;fill:currentColor;text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:central}
</style>
<circle class="bg" cx="50" cy="50" r="40"/>
<circle class="val" cx="50" cy="50" r="40" pathLength="100"/>
<text class="n" x="50" y="50">{{pct}}%</text>
</svg>
